'''Byluir''' was a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Byluir was promoted to the rank of Moff and placed in command of the [[Thirteenth Army|13th Sector Army]], also known as "Iron Lance Command". The 13th Sector Army was charged with protecting the [[Trans-Nebular Oversector]], an area that Byluir effectively had complete power over.<ref name="TEGtW" />
